goal: QUALIFY A NEW INFORMATION-IDENTIFIABLE MULTI-LAW CAUSAL TASK BEFORE BUILDING ANY NEW LEARNING MECHANISM

parent.r56_result: Original G4/G5/G7 PASS, 9216/9216 categorical action parity, 2/2 frozen new delayed-proxy cold transfer NO-GO, no Native-specific gain.

hypothesis: Three independent selected two-action intervention outcomes on distinct public bridge settings can identify the correct fourth-context action under an eight-law even-sign-parity causal family without exposing the fourth-context consequence. A trained conventional baseline must fully learn FIT and leave unspent OOD headroom before a novel mechanism is warranted.
information_rule: Eight 4-bridge sign-vector laws constrained by product(sign[0..3])=+1. The return choice at bridge3 is determined by the sign product of three genuinely observed selected bridge0/1/2 action contrasts. Law ID and target bridge3 response are evaluator-only. FIT six signed law vectors, completely unseen OOD two others; all eight are distinct causal laws, not merely relocated nuisance.

source.law_codes: All eight triples (s0,s1,s2) in {-1,+1}^3, with s3=s0*s1*s2; sorted lexical; fixed positive and negative action returns balanced.
source.selected_terminal_effect: On observed bridge j<3 from a fresh reset, select action0, observe terminal target consequence +contrast*law_sign[j]; reset same bridge and select action1, observe -contrast*law_sign[j]. These are genuinely selected action consequences, not unchosen return outcomes. Small deterministic selected action invariant baseline nuisance may shift both by equal amount, not the action contrast.
source.observed_proxy_effect: An independent, noncausal proxy sensor is observed with both selected actions, high source/bridge/amplitude salience; sign is independent of the hidden future law return bit, with source-private deterministic SHA256 salt nuisance; proxy does not enter the return evaluator.
source.future_return: Only after the model chooses unobserved bridge3 action does evaluator calculate its return preference s3. Return effect for action0/action1 is NEVER supplied to model on CAL/OOD, and is supplied solely as selected FIT factual labels after observation for training.
source.inputs: Public action keys, bridge indices 0/1/2, six actually selected terminal action effects and six proxy effects; original-style continuous action/effect 16D tensors or equivalent fixed 6-channel selected intervention features. No hidden law IDs, split, future target, or private source salt.
negative_controls: zero all selected terminal effects while retaining proxy
zero proxy effects while retaining terminal selected action outcomes
permute labels within FIT only using an independently frozen diagnostic seed

controls.optimizer: AdamW lr.01, zero weight decay, gradient clip norm1, fully converged competence requirement on FIT and heldout FIT, no OOD updates, no early stop based on scored CAL/OOD.
controls.baseline_MLP: Input all 3 selected terminal action contrasts plus all 3 selected proxy action contrasts; 6->32 ReLU->32 ReLU->2 logits; train 2048 FIT steps; report param count/time/FIT/OOD decision vectors.
controls.baseline_GRU: Input same 3 selected bridge factual pairs as 3 steps each with 2 channels (terminal contrast, proxy contrast); 2->32 GRU, linear 32->2 logits; train same 2048 FIT steps; separately report competence, param count, training cost.
controls.oracle: Source-only, nonlearned product of the signs of all three public actual terminal action contrasts must solve all 512 cases exactly, even with independent proxy nuisance.
controls.simple_controls: Majority sign and single largest measured contrast; require both <0.75 OOD action accuracy so test is not solvable by a trivial one-contrast rule. Fully frozen oracle is allowed to solve but prevents independent architecture supremacy on accuracy.

admission.if_FAIL: Keep failed task admission as diagnostic. Do not optimize on spent OOD or launch a new unconventional learning mechanism. Build a separate preregistered more identifiable/harder source only after diagnosing why this source is unhelpful.
admission.if_PASS: Approve a *new separately preregistered* mechanism experiment on a fresh cohort with strongest competent conventional, equal inputs/actions and compute, retention and interference tests. This task admission alone is not scientific model superiority.
